notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.5 Hat rolls done right, a real comp editor, and three new bundled effects — Motion, Tape, and Choir. Added - Hat rolls (per-step ratchet). Leave a track on 1/16 and let one step fire three, four, or six times — the fast hat retriggers that make a beat breathe, without changing the grid. Right-click a step, or a whole track, and pick a roll. - Generative roll placement. Roll ▸ Generate rolls scatters tasteful rolls for you — offbeats, bar ends, pickups before beats 2 and 4, sparse or busy. It only ornaments steps that are already playing, and it's repeatable per pattern rather than random every time. - RATCHET automation lane. In the arranger, ramp hats from a straight 1/16 up into triplets through a build and back down. Quantised to musical counts so it never sounds sloppy. - Comp editor (take lanes). For vocals and any looped takes: right-click a track ▸ Comp ▸ Open comp editor. One lane per take with its waveform — drag across bars to claim them, right-drag to clear, double-click to audition. Works for both audio and MIDI takes, in its own resizable window. - Three new bundled effects — now 28 FX. Eclipse Motion (movement/modulation), Eclipse Tape (saturation and wow/flutter), and Eclipse Choir all ship inside Eclipse Loop. Buyers get every one. Fixed - Undo in the sequencer now shows immediately. With playback stopped, Cmd+Z changed the pattern but left the old grid on screen until you pressed play — it now repaints right away. On tracks with a division override, undo also covers the whole row instead of just the first half. - Right-click menus open at the pointer. Sequencer menus used to appear at the far left edge no matter where you clicked.
